invite-modal-v2.png.note: Re-captured 2026-08-25 from live staging by scripts/capture/shoot.js with the declarative spec scripts/capture/shots/how-to-invite-users.js (reshoot pilot). Same 1120x1216 raw as 2026-08-14: [role=dialog] bounding box + 40px margin on all sides, one sample chip (team@example.com) in the Emails field, input blurred so no focus ring shows. FIXES A CONTENT DEFECT in the 2026-08-14 capture: that final read 'Invites are valid for 1 week', which contradicted the article body's '7 days'. It was not a product change -- dom-sanitize's freshenDates default remaps any '<n> <unit>' onto a recency ladder, and it silently rewrote the dialog's own product copy. This capture disables freshenDates, and the footer now reads the true string 'Invites are valid for 7 days and the email must match at signup.' Emails still sanitized (14 rewritten): the member rows behind the dimmed backdrop fall inside the +40px pad. No cursor: filled-form state, nothing to point at.
